filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selection offered strong, specific choices for all topics. The Arabic selection was more challenging, with one topic ('Applying the Job Characteristics Model') having no suitable candidates. For 'Scaling Organizational Culture' in Arabic, an exception was made for view count as no video met the initial threshold.
